title: cloudflare-minter/v1
description: The credential sluis mints Cloudflare tokens with, at the internal address <root>/internal/cloudflare/<account>/minter that cloudflare.accounts.<name>.minter names: an account API token that holds Account API Tokens Read and Edit and nothing else. The document is internal: sluis reads it, nobody else is granted it. Every field is a string. Adding a field is not breaking; removing, renaming or re-typing one is.
